# Grasp yellow_mug near its top rim or select a candidate with clearance to avoid motion_blocked
cands = grasp_candidates("yellow_mug")

# Look for candidates that are clear or have higher grasp height
best_cand = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and c.get("hand_clear", False) and c.get("fingers_clear", False):
        best_cand = c
        break

    best_cand = max(valid_cands, key=lambda c: c["height"])
    # Ensure height is near the top of the mug (~0.058 - 0.065 m above table)
    best_cand["height"] = max(best_cand["height"], 0.06)

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["blue_coaster"]
cx, cy = zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1]
rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.0)

clear_h = max(0.18, rim_h + 0.12)
place_at_position(cx, cy, clear_height=clear_h, retreat_height=0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_mug", "blue_coaster")

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["red_bin"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_paper")

# Filter for candidates that avoid collision with the adjacent red_bin
valid_candidates = [
    c for c in candidates 
    if c.get("hand_clear", True) and c.get("fingers_clear", True)
]

if not valid_candidates:
    # If none have both clear, pick the one with lowest obstacle height or best clearance
    valid_candidates = sorted(
        candidates, 
        key=lambda c: (c.get("highest_obstacle_under_hand_m", 1.0), -c.get("score", 0))
    )

chosen = valid_candidates[0]
res = grasp(chosen)

if res.get("holding_something", False):
    drop_into_container(zone, clear_offset=0.12, retreat_height=0.15)
    check("cyan_paper", "red_bin")

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["red_bin"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_paper")

# Red bin is at [-0.0281, -0.2455], cyan_paper is at [-0.1196, -0.2631].
# The hand/fingers collide with the bin wall (x > -0.1196, closer to bin center).
# Look for a candidate oriented along y-axis or adjust yaw and shift slightly away from the bin (-x direction).
# If fingers squeeze along y (yaw ~ 1.57 or -1.57), the hand body (0.21m along yaw) extends in +/- y, away from x!
# In the failed attempt, yaw=0.022 (along x-axis), so the hand body/fingers extended directly towards the bin!
candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(abs(c["yaw"]) - math.pi / 2))
chosen = dict(candidates_sorted[0])

# Ensure yaw is ~ 1.57 so the gripper body lies along y-axis, clear of the bin rim
chosen["yaw"] = 1.57
# Shift slightly away from the bin along x
chosen["x"] -= 0.01

res = grasp(chosen)
if res.get("holding_something", False):
    drop_into_container(zone, clear_offset=0.12, retreat_height=0.15)
    check("cyan_paper", "red_bin")
